thread:
inc-bot: [P1] Dedicated pool 'orphean-enterprise' capacity alarm — GPUs at 94%, queue depth 118, tail latency elevated. Paging on-call. https://console.redwood/incident/5151515151 :rotating_light:

kai (oncall): taking. quick summary? what broke first — steady load or spike?

michael_sre: seeing sustained increase in concurrent sessions from customer ip ranges. looks like model warmup + long requests. KV cache miss rate up 42%.

sara_infra: confirmed GPUs saturated on pool 'dedicated-eu-orphean-01'. autoscaler hasn't triggered because pool is pinned to 0 burst nodes. burst policy is 'manual-approval' for this tenant.

chloe_csm: @kai @michael_sre heads-up — Orphean CS reported increased 503s starting ~10:23 UTC, high impact for prod customers. They asked for ETA.

aj_pm: we should evaluate a temporary burst and also ask Orphean if they're running a heavy rollout. Chloe can you check?

chloe_csm: reached out to Orphean engineering, waiting on confirmation. They say a canary expanded traffic to 50% at 10:15 — might be correlated.

kai (oncall): propose mitigations: 1) approve ephemeral burst +4 gpus (30m) 2) throttle lower-priority jobs in the same pool 3) fail open to hosted model (fallback) if burst not possible. which do we want?

michael_sre: prefer burst + throttling. throttling requires policy change: set tenant priority to 'high' and preempt batch tenants. I can run preempt if approved. Command to add burst: ```/infra burst --tenant orphean-enterprise --count 4 --type ephemeral --duration 30m```

sara_infra: if we do burst we need ops approval for quota bump. ops, assigning to infra-approvers. @sara_infra approving if infra CLI shows available capacity. checking now...

sara_infra: available capacity in eu region = 6 GPUs. Burst +4 OK. I'll pre-authorize.

kai (oncall): executing burst now. michael, please run preempt step after I confirm nodes show up.

michael_sre: saw 4 nodes provisioning, K8s pods scheduling. running preempt to evict non-prod lower-priority pods: ```rbctl tenant preempt --pool dedicated-eu-orphean-01 --priority<=low```

inc-bot: Burst job started by kai (oncall) — request id b-515151-3. New capacity expected in ~90s.

chloe_csm: Orphean says they're pausing the canary now to confirm. thanks team.

michael_sre: KV cache hit rate improving, queue length dropping to 32, p50 latency back to normal. still watching p95.

kai (oncall): monitoring metrics dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/dedicated-eu-orphean-01 — will keep burst for 30m and reassess. Chloe pls let Orphean know estimated recovery.

chloe_csm: messaging sent: "We've added temporary capacity and are monitoring; please confirm if you re-enable canary." They replied ack.

aj_pm: postmortem action items: 1) evaluate changing policy to auto-burst for this tenant under threshold X, 2) run a traffic test with Orphean for cache priming doc, 3) add runbook step to auto-notify CSM on capacity alarms.

kai (oncall): handing off to michael for next 30m watch. I'm pausing pager for 30m. @michael_sre you have primary. :white_check_mark:

michael_sre: got it, taking watch. will update if metrics deviate.

inc-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated (temporary capacity added). Ticket: INC-5151515151. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to aj_pm.

chloe_csm: thanks all — I'll schedule a 1:1 postmortem with Orphean tomorrow to agree on rate limits and deployment cadence. :thumbsup:

michael_sre: marking resolved for immediate customer impact, keeping incident open for follow-up until postmortem complete.

kai (oncall): nice work team.
